name: Closed-Loop DPCM Decompression
definition: Decompresses a CompressedTraceBlock using closed-loop DPCM. Reads bit depth from payload. Falls back to legacy decoder if payload is not closed-loop.
summary: Closed-Loop DPCM Decompression reconstructs volumetric data by using previously decoded values for prediction, preventing the error accumulation found in open-loop variants.
